select_region.title: Select your Livoltek region
select_region.description: Choose the region where your Livoltek account is registered.

credentials.title: Enter your API credentials
credentials.info_text: Three parameters from the Livoltek portal are required. Click (?) next to each field for detailed instructions.
credentials.secuid_hint: Found in Livoltek profile under Security ID
credentials.secuid_help: Open your profile on Livoltek portal → Security ID → click "+ Add" → in the Operate column click Copy. The system will copy Security ID and Key in JSON format. Copy the value of the "secuid" field and paste it here. If the Operate column is empty, refresh the browser page and open the profile again.
credentials.key_hint: Found in the same JSON as Security User ID
credentials.key_help: Use the same instructions as for Security User ID. In the copied JSON find the "key" field and copy its value here. The trailing \n or \r\n at the end of the key may be included or left out - the app adds the correct line ending itself.
credentials.token_hint: Generate via "Generate Token" button in profile
credentials.token_help: Open your profile on Livoltek portal → Generate Token → click "+ Add" → in the Operate column click Copy to copy the token. Paste the copied token into this field. The token has an expiration date, so store it in a secure place.

pair.login_failed: Login failed. Please check your credentials.

error.connection_failed: Failed to connect to Livoltek API
